title: Tibber's tomorrow prices are dropped: the payload parser reads only 'today'
claim: price_model.prices_from_tibber_payload iterates period in ('today',) only, so a Tibber payload carrying today and tomorrow (96+96 quarter rows) returns 96 rows, and a plan solved at 14:00 knows 40 of its 96 steps instead of 96: the rest is filled from the learned prior.
mechanism: price_model.py:719 `for period in ("today",)`; the query (TIBBER_PRICE_QUERY[_QUARTER]) requests tomorrow and the entity path (prices_from_entity_attributes) reads raw_tomorrow/tomorrow. After the day-ahead auction the published prices past midnight never reach coordinator._known_prices_for, so price_known is False there and extend_price_series substitutes the prior's guess (with its sigma, risk-priced when price_risk_lambda > 0).

evidence.contention_note: fan-out: up to three seats share the box; a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb tomorrow: the parser also folds priceInfo.tomorrow

metric_definition: tibber_rows_dropped = rows of a 192-row today+tomorrow Tibber payload not returned; tibber_known_steps_at_14h = steps of a 96-step plan at 14:00 the coordinator marks price_known
phenomenon_property: Every published price row a source delivers inside the horizon reaches the plan as known; the two ingress paths (Tibber, entity) read the same days.

null_control.value: known_steps 96/96 with --perturb tomorrow; at 00:07 the same payload already covers the whole horizon from today
null_control.note: the loss is the 56 steps past midnight
